-- AMBIGUOUS RECORD --------------------------------- main.fango

I cannot tell which record this is. Write its type name before the `{`, as in
`TypeName { ... }`, or add an annotation that gives it one. Field
names alone never choose a record type.

6| main() = print (run { x = 1 })
                       ^^^^^^^^^

If you meant a function, `{ x = 1 }` is a record: a function that produces a value is `{ value }`.
